title: 8BitDo Arcade Controller Pro Available for Pre-Order
excerpt: 8BitDo's new button-only Arcade Controller Pro is available for pre-order, priced at $119.99 with shipping set to begin in late November.
body_html:
Gaming accessory maker 8BitDo has opened pre-orders for its newest button-only arcade controller. The Arcade Controller Pro is priced at $119.99.

According to the announcement, customers who pre-order the device can expect shipments to begin in late November.
